vision.name: Namekian Imposing Mastery
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: Use when you would Rejuvenate a Styled [Attack] card during combat. You may place it into your hand instead.
POWER: Shuffle the top and bottom cards of your discard pile into your Life Deck.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title strip below the art (read from a crop of the original); DR number printed; the inline icon in the first Power is the attack (crossed swords) symbol used as an adjective
